### Collaborative source (real SQL in PGlite)

131/480 readers received collaborative rows; mean 6.7 rows; mean neighbours 2.9; mean SQL time 33 ms per first (refreshing) call in single-connection PGlite, which is not production Postgres.

Client scoring cost per slate (JS, this machine): v1 1.4 ± 0.1 ms; v2_metadata 4.2 ± 0.2 ms; v2_hybrid 4.4 ± 0.2 ms.

## TV wall: whole-show rankers (synthetic)

360 non-cold-start test readers, each evaluated three times with their titles recorded as TV: `whole_show` (every ranked title a whole-show ranking — the whole-show-ranker slice), `by_season` (one to three seasons each) and `show_and_seasons` (the show and two seasons, the double-count case). `v2m-pre-ws5` is V2 metadata with the pre-reconcile profile, which ignored whole-show rankings.
